long_biography.plain_text:
Lexington native Samuel A. B. “Alex” Boone earned a business administration degree from the University of Kentucky in 1982. He established private ventures in the following years and was identified as the owner of Sterling Ventures’ Kentucky limestone mine by 1999. The business supplies crushed stone for roads, concrete and other construction uses, alongside high-calcium limestone for industrial customers.

Boone remains Sterling Ventures’ chief executive while maintaining an extensive civic and equestrian portfolio. He serves as a University of Kentucky trustee, vice-chair of the Kentucky Horse Park Commission and board member of the U.S. Equestrian Federation. His current service also includes chairing the Markey Cancer Center Foundation and leading campaign work for the U.S. Equestrian Team Foundation.
